data.description: Litter is the first complaint in any busy park, and a bin that is easy to spot is more likely to be used. The Grin Barrel Bin is a barrel-shaped dustbin clad in wooden slats, held at a tilt by a looping yellow steel stand. Its angled mouth faces the user, so children can drop wrappers in without reaching over a high rim. It fits a play area entrance, a school courtyard or a resort pool deck, and its slats match our benches. The Grin Barrel Bin is in our CoreCraft garden decor range with Sand Beige as the listed colour, although the stand in the photo is yellow. Capacity, size and warranty terms come with the quote, and we can place bins on your layout drawing.

items.pText: Litter is the first complaint in any busy park, and a bin that is easy to spot is more likely to be used. The Grin Barrel Bin is a barrel-shaped dustbin clad in wooden slats, held at a tilt by a looping yellow steel stand. Its angled mouth faces the user, so children can drop wrappers in without reaching over a high rim. It fits a play area entrance, a school courtyard or a resort pool deck, and its slats match our benches. The Grin Barrel Bin is in our CoreCraft garden decor range with Sand Beige as the listed colour, although the stand in the photo is yellow. Capacity, size and warranty terms come with the quote, and we can place bins on your layout drawing.

The yellow stand is anchored to the ground, self-standing on a slab or grouted, so the barrel cannot be knocked over. Keep bins outside the safe play area of nearby equipment. Empty and rinse the barrel often during the monsoon, and check that the fixings holding the barrel to the stand stay tight.
